theorem fiberwise_dist_lt_imp_dist_lt_unique_decoding_radius (i : Fin ℓ) (steps : ℕ)
    [NeZero steps] (h_i_add_steps : i.val + steps ≤ ℓ)
    (f : OracleFunction 𝔽q β (h_ℓ_add_R_rate := h_ℓ_add_R_rate) ⟨i, by omega⟩)
  (h_fw_dist_lt : fiberwiseClose 𝔽q β (h_ℓ_add_R_rate := h_ℓ_add_R_rate)
    (i := i) (steps := steps) (h_i_add_steps := h_i_add_steps) (f := f)) :
  hammingClose 𝔽q β (h_ℓ_add_R_rate := h_ℓ_add_R_rate) ⟨i, by omega⟩ f := by
  unfold fiberwiseClose at h_fw_dist_lt
  unfold hammingClose
  let C_i := BBF_Code 𝔽q β (h_ℓ_add_R_rate := h_ℓ_add_R_rate) ⟨i, by omega⟩
  have h_C_i_nonempty : Nonempty C_i := Submodule.nonempty C_i
  have h_d_i_gt_0 : (BBF_CodeDistance ℓ 𝓡 ⟨i, by omega⟩) > 0 := by
    dsimp only [BBF_CodeDistance]; omega
  let d_fw := fiberwiseDistance 𝔽q β (i := i) steps h_i_add_steps f
  obtain ⟨g', hg'_mem, hg'_min⟩ : ∃ g' ∈ C_i, d_fw = (fiberwiseDisagreementSet 𝔽q β i steps h_i_add_steps f g').ncard := by
    let S := (fun (g : C_i) => (fiberwiseDisagreementSet 𝔽q β i steps h_i_add_steps f g).ncard) '' Set.univ
    have hS_nonempty : S.Nonempty := Set.image_nonempty.mpr Set.univ_nonempty
    have h_sInf_mem : sInf S ∈ S := Nat.sInf_mem hS_nonempty
    rcases h_sInf_mem with ⟨g_subtype, _, h_eq⟩
    exact ⟨g_subtype.val, g_subtype.property, by exact id (Eq.symm h_eq)⟩
  have h_hamming_le : (hammingDist f g' : ℕ∞) ≤ d_fw * 2 ^ steps := by
    set ΔH := Finset.filter (fun x => f x ≠ g' x) Finset.univ
    set Y_bad := fiberwiseDisagreementSet 𝔽q β i steps h_i_add_steps f g'
    have hFinType_Y_bad : Fintype ↑Y_bad := Fintype.ofFinite ↑Y_bad
    have h_ΔH_subset : ΔH ⊆ Finset.biUnion Y_bad.toFinset
        (fun y => (qMap_total_fiber 𝔽q β ⟨i, by omega⟩ steps (by omega) y '' Finset.univ).toFinset) := by
      intro x hx; simp only [mem_filter, ΔH] at hx
      let y := iteratedQuotientMap 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate i steps h_i_add_steps x
      apply Finset.mem_biUnion.mpr; use y
      have h_y_in_Y : y ∈ Y_bad.toFinset := by
        simp only [fiberwiseDisagreementSet, iteratedQuotientMap, ne_eq, Subtype.exists, Set.toFinset_setOf,
          mem_filter, mem_univ, true_and, Y_bad]
        use x.val; exact Submodule.coe_mem x
        simp only [Polynomial.eval, intermediateNormVpoly, Subtype.coe_eta, not_false_eq_true, and_self]
      have h_x_in_fiber : x ∈ (qMap_total_fiber 𝔽q β ⟨i, by omega⟩ steps (by omega) y '' Finset.univ).toFinset := by
        simp only [coe_univ, Set.image_univ, Set.toFinset_range, mem_image, mem_univ, true_and]
        use (pointToIterateQuotientIndex i steps (by omega) x)
        exact is_fiber_iff_generates_quotient_point 𝔽q β i steps (by omega) x y
      exact ⟨h_y_in_Y, h_x_in_fiber⟩
    have h_card : (ΔH.toFinset.card : ℕ∞) ≤ (Y_bad.toFinset.card : ℕ∞) * 2 ^ steps := by
      calc (ΔH.toFinset.card : ℕ∞) ≤ (Finset.biUnion Y_bad.toFinset
          (fun y => (qMap_total_fiber 𝔽q β ⟨i, by omega⟩ steps (by omega) y '' Finset.univ).toFinset).card : ℕ∞) :=
          Finset.card_le_card h_ΔH_subset
        _ = ∑ y ∈ Y_bad.toFinset, (qMap_total_fiber 𝔽q β ⟨i, by omega⟩ steps (by omega) y '' Finset.univ).toFinset.card := by
          rw [Finset.card_biUnion]; intro y₁ hy₁ y₂ hy₂; exact qMap_total_fiber_disjoint i steps (by omega) y₁ y₂
        _ = ∑ y ∈ Y_bad.toFinset, 2 ^ steps := by
          rw [Finset.sum_congr rfl]; intro y hy; simp only [Set.image_univ, Fintype.card_ofFinset]
          exact card_qMap_total_fiber 𝔽q β i steps h_i_add_steps
        _ = Y_bad.toFinset.card * 2 ^ steps := by simp only [sum_const, Set.toFinset_card, smul_eq_mul]
    rw [hg'_min] at h_card
    exact h_card
  have h_d_H_le : Code.distFromCode f C_i ≤ d_fw * 2 ^ steps := by
    simp only [Code.distFromCode, SetLike.mem_coe, hammingDist, ne_eq]
    apply sInf_le
    use g'
    exact ⟨hg'_mem, h_hamming_le⟩
  have h_fw_bound : 2 * d_fw ≤ (BBF_CodeDistance ℓ 𝓡 ⟨i.val + steps, by omega⟩) - 1 := by
    exact Nat.le_of_lt_succ (WithTop.coe_lt_coe.1 h_fw_dist_lt)
  have h_algebraic : ((BBF_CodeDistance ℓ 𝓡 ⟨i.val + steps, by omega⟩) - 1) * 2 ^ steps = (BBF_CodeDistance ℓ 𝓡 ⟨i, by omega⟩) - 1 := by
    dsimp only [BBF_CodeDistance, Nat.add_one_sub_one]
    rw [Nat.sub_mul, ←Nat.pow_add, ←Nat.pow_add]
    have h1 : ℓ + 𝓡 - (↑i + steps) + steps = ℓ + 𝓡 - ↑i := by omega
    have h2 : ℓ - (↑i + steps) + steps = ℓ - ↑i := by omega
    rw [h1, h2]
  have h_d_H_ne_top : Code.distFromCode f C_i ≠ ⊤ := by
    simp only [ne_eq, Code.distFromCode_eq_top_iff_empty f C_i]
    exact Set.nonempty_iff_ne_empty'.mp h_C_i_nonempty
  let d_H := ENat.toNat (Code.distFromCode f C_i)
  have h_d_H_eq : Code.distFromCode f C_i = d_H := (ENat.coe_toNat h_d_H_ne_top).symm
  have h_final : 2 * d_H ≤ (BBF_CodeDistance ℓ 𝓡 ⟨i, by omega⟩) - 1 := by
    calc 2 * d_H = 2 * ↑(Code.distFromCode f C_i) := by rw [h_d_H_eq]; simp only [ENat.coe_toNat]
    _ ≤ 2 * (d_fw * 2 ^ steps) := by gcongr; exact h_d_H_le
    _ = (2 * d_fw) * 2 ^ steps := by rw [mul_assoc]
    _ ≤ ((BBF_CodeDistance ℓ 𝓡 ⟨i.val + steps, by omega⟩) - 1) * 2 ^ steps := by gcongr; exact h_fw_bound
    _ = (BBF_CodeDistance ℓ 𝓡 ⟨i, by omega⟩) - 1 := h_algebraic
  rw [h_d_H_eq]
  change ((2 : ℕ) : ℕ∞) * ↑(Code.distFromCode f C_i) < ↑(BBF_CodeDistance ℓ 𝓡 ⟨i, by omega⟩)
  rw [←ENat.coe_mul, ENat.coe_lt_coe]
  apply Nat.lt_of_le_pred (n := 2 * Code.distFromCode f C_i) (m := BBF_CodeDistance ℓ 𝓡 ⟨i, by omega⟩) (h := h_d_i_gt_0)
  exact h_final
